title: California ZIP nonrenewal and FAIR-share differences vary with place income and housing structure
source_unit: California ZIP-level FAIR/private-market crosswalk joined to ACS 2022 ZCTA income and structure context

observations.period: 2022; equal-count ZIP quartiles by ACS place context

denominator.unit: FAIR ZIP rows with voluntary decisions and usable ACS ZCTA context

lowest_income_quartile_nonrenewal_rate.unit: percent among voluntary renewed plus nonrenewed decisions

highest_income_quartile_nonrenewal_rate.unit: percent among voluntary renewed plus nonrenewed decisions

lowest_income_quartile_mean_fair_share.unit: percent of residential structures, mean of ZIP percentages

highest_income_quartile_mean_fair_share.unit: percent of residential structures, mean of ZIP percentages

lowest_detached_share_quartile_nonrenewa.unit: percent among voluntary renewed plus nonrenewed decisions

highest_detached_share_quartile_nonrenew.unit: percent among voluntary renewed plus nonrenewed decisions

observations.method: Matched FAIR ZIP rows and 2022 voluntary-market decisions to ACS 2022 5-year ZCTA median household income and units-in-structure estimates; compared equal-count quartiles using voluntary nonrenewed/(renewed+nonrenewed).
observations.uncertainty: ACS ZCTAs approximate ZIP geography and are five-year place estimates. FAIR and voluntary measures have different universes; quartiles are unweighted and context is not an individual insured-household measure.
observations.subgroup: FAIR ZIP rows with valid income, structure, and 2022 voluntary decision context.
observations.counterinterpretation: Income and detached-home share may proxy hazard, property value, insurer mix, urban/rural composition, or reporting differences; this does not show that income or structure caused nonrenewal or FAIR enrollment.

related_sources.claim: ACS supplies units-in-structure estimates used for detached-home and mobile-home context.
related_sources.access_boundary: These are five-year ZCTA estimates, not insured-property records.

related_sources.claim: Local output records the join and quartile calculations.
related_sources.access_boundary: The join is descriptive and denominator-mismatched.

boundary: This record adds income and housing-structure place context to the California FAIR/private-market ZIP screen. It does not establish causality, household affordability, coverage adequacy, repairs, moves, or political response.
